newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks stalled in dull holiday mood.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks stalled in dull holiday mood.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks marked time in dull, wet December weather which added to the lethargy caused by the upcoming holidays, brokers said on Tuesday.
The all share index was 0.8 points lower at the mid- morning break.
"Investors have other things on their minds, like the holidays," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena a trader at Commercial Stock Brokers.
The dull, wet weather which has prevented retail investors from visiting brokers' offices, has also added to the lethargy, he said.

Morning turnover was 2.5 million rupees. The main trades of the morning were 20,000 CT Land shares 25 cents down at 10.75, 25,000 Seylan Bank 25 cents down at 25.25 and 12,000 Vanik 25 cents down at 16.25, brokers said.
